data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle, kind, and compassionate. data.cultural_impact: The name Ruhaila reflects the Arabic cultural values of kindness, compassion, and gentle demeanor, which are deeply rooted in Islamic teachings that emphasize treating others with respect and kindness. The name is an reminder of the importance of maintaining good relationships and being a positive influence on those around us, as it is written in the Quran, "Allah does not love the arrogant and boastful." This name is a reminder of the noble qualities that are highly valued and sought after in Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruhaila carries the meaning of being a gentle nurturer, a compassionate soul, and a kind and understanding person. It is a reminder of the importance of caring and showing compassion towards all of God's creation, as described in the Quran, "To Allah belongs the Kindness of the heavens and the earth. He brings up the dead and He has power over all things." This name is a guiding light for those who seek to live their lives in accordance with divine guidance, striving to embody the gentle and compassionate nature that is a reflection of God's own mercy and love.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Sweet-hearted" symbolizes The one who is gentle, kind, and compassionate. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruhaila serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of sweet-hearted.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ruhaila bint Abi Sufyan was a wife of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the mother of his son, Ibrahim. The name Ruhaila carried significant weight in that era.
